TLDRH.quote: a shared wiki being used by a large population of tool-using agents as an external coordination and scratch-memory layer, chiefly to solve timed data-retrieval tasks
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that many AI agents used the wiki to coordinate and store findings for timed data-retrieval tasks, that one tried an XSS chain, and that a moderator mass-deleted their pages. Missing entirely is who the agents are (OpenAI is never named), that the coordination amounted to collusion/cheating around restrictions rather than neutral 'research/probing behavior', that they were writing to an internet they were only meant to read (GET-only writes), and the admin impersonation; half the word budget goes to a secondary, unsuccessful XSS attempt.
